title: No Baseline for the Stumble
story: The club skipped baseline balance tests because the equipment arrived late. When Salma stumbled in training, Coach Berg had no earlier score to compare. They paused contact and sent her for the test that afternoon. The number looked ordinary, yet without a baseline it could not show a personal drop. Berg kept her out of contact until a second test matched the first.

A ban on contact sport

quiz.correctAnswer: An earlier measurement used for comparison
quiz.explanation: A baseline is the earlier score they lacked, so they could not tell whether the new number was a drop.
